inputs.text: Listen, this march of tens of thousands through central London on Saturday, billed as the supposed biggest protest against the far-right, is just another coordinated elite setup. It follows right after one of the largest far-right turnouts six months ago and comes weeks before those key local elections, organized by hundreds of groups including trade unions, anti-racism outfits, and Muslim representative bodies under the Together Alliance banner. This is clearly a manufactured crisis to brand any genuine resistance as extreme, split the public, and rig the elections so nobody questions who's really pulling the strings from behind the scenes.
